state.seed_assertion: If processing involves invisible processing combined with any vulnerable individuals or other criteria, a DPIA must be conducted to help assess and mitigate impact on individuals' ability to exercise control over their data.

sentences.1: This could help foster trust in your processing activities, and improve individuals' ability to exercise their rights.
sentences.2: Publishing a DPIA is good practice to foster trust and improve individuals' ability to exercise their rights.
sentences.3: If you have decided to accept a high risk, either because it is not possible to mitigate or because the costs of mitigation are too high, you must consult the ICO before you go ahead with the processing.
sentences.4: A DPIA is an ongoing process for managing risks, not a one-time exercise, and must be reevaluated when the risk represented by the processing operation changes.
sentences.5: Carrying out a DPIA is not a one-time exercise.
